items.title: 56711_Buster Smith oral history interview
items.q: Dee Stewart -- they called him Prince Stewart. He had a little seven- or eight-piece band down at the Continental Club... We were working from 8 to 5 in the morning... I'd look around there and it looked like the band was playing too slow

ctx.x: And who else did you work with among those other Kansas City bands?
Dee Stewart -- they called him Prince Stewart. He had a little seven- or eight-piece band down at the Continental Club.
Anybody good in that, other than you? Anybody well known?
